text:
**Notice: Repair Café Location Change**

Our Saturday repair sessions are moving from the library to the Community Hall! 

Join us this Saturday at our new venue. Volunteers, please arrive at 9:30 AM to help set up. We look forward to welcoming visitors and their broken items starting at 10:00 AM. 

See you there!
task: Write a notice explaining that a fictional neighborhood repair cafe will move its Saturday session from the library to the community hall. Volunteers should arrive at 9:30 and visitors at 10.
